description: This file defines the 'PermissionList' class, which encapsulates a list of 'Permission' objects along with a total count, used for handling permission data in the application.

classes.name: PermissionList
classes.description: A serializable class representing a list of permissions with a total count.

methods.name: getTotalCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of permissions.

methods.name: setTotalCount
methods.description: Sets the total number of permissions.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Returns the list of Permission objects.

methods.name: setPermissions
methods.description: Sets the list of Permission objects.
